scope: Original XML → parameter model → template dispatch, triggers, subscriptions and commands; NImage complex sample. Framework design evidence, not plugin closure.

authorityLegend.decompiled-original-source: Original shipped managed assemblies decompiled; statement tied to excerpt and binary identity.
authorityLegend.controlled-original-parser: Original parser/custom operations instantiated with explicitly synthetic parameter and IVmModule owners; no real VM IO mutation or desktop window.

evidence.claim: XML attributes/children map to public fields; list tags are reflected registered model types, with parent and AfterAddedToArray hooks. Unknown names are not a generic widget schema.
AlgorithmTabRoot loads XML with parser namespace, then initializes and dispatches XML-loaded hooks.
GroupLinkItem removes itself, clones the named shared GroupInfoItem and appends its child models with the original parent. It is an expansion macro, not a rendered group.
Category supplies inherited subscription/delete-binding/execution settings; child rows retain group identity.
Tab flattens category items for the grouped renderer and name lookup.
Property changes reset matching working operations before applying the matching triggers; execution is deferred until nested trigger processing finishes.
MultiTrigger resolves local or other-item properties, converts typed expected values and combines equality conditions with AND(default) or OR.
Setter invokes registered operation and can additionally assign target PropertyName+A; operation parameters are split on semicolon.
OperationManager resolves operation classes from ActivatorWrap registration; exact operation spelling is part of XML identity.
VisibleOperation saves previous visibility and restores it on ReOperate, rather than permanently toggling a row.
Command click performs its setter operation before SetParamUnit and change notification. Model values, user commits and initialization are distinct.
ValueBase dynamically creates SubData subscription selector and persists @ComName subscription state; this is separate from tool input IO wiring.
SetFilterSourceOperation resolves and validates typed input/output references then mutates RelateIO and RelateIndex; display text alone is not a binding.
PreExecuteRun checks global IsParamModifyExecute and inherited CanTriggerExecute, defers nested work, then invokes the module run path with busy guards.
The original CloseParamsTabControl delegates to the window close command; this alone does not establish modal versus nonmodal lifetime.
Explicit SelfExcuteModule exists in the command model but NImage does not declare it in its footer.
SaveCalibPath searches tabs for hidden SaveFileDialog and invokes its save action.
Clear writes owner.Params[Clear]=1 then optionally reports success/failure. NeedPopTip is post-action feedback, not Yes/No permission.
ResetAlgoParams has its own confirmation, clears run parameter bindings, calls owner.ResetParam and reloads item values under reset guard.
ParamUserControl binds ContentTemplate to DisplayType and can load plugin assembly DataTemplate dictionaries. ExternDisplayType explicitly overrides dispatch.
UserTempConverter selects an exact resource key; absent keys use Default template.
Common shell is TabsA plus grouped scroll content and fixed 32px footer; left commands are shown only on Tab_Run Params. Footer content comes from declared command collections.

      <FrameworkElement.Style>
        <Style BasedOn="{StaticResource BottomButtonStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type Button}">
          <Setter Property="Command" Value="{Binding ClickCommand}" />
          <Style.Triggers>
            <DataTrigger Value="True" Binding="{Binding Path=Solution.(VMInterface:IVmSolution.IsContinuousSelfExecute)}">
              <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" />
            </DataTrigger>
            <DataTrigger Value="True" Binding="{Binding Path=Procedure.(VMInterface:IVMRun.IsRunning)}">
              <Setter Property="IsEnabled" Value="False" />
            </DataTrigger>
            <DataTrigger Value="False" Binding="{Binding Path=Procedure.(VMInterface:IVMRun.RunEnable)}">
              <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" />
            </DataTrigger>
          </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>
      </FrameworkElement.Style>

boundaries: Full original BAML host rendering failed separately with Baml2006SchemaContext.ResolveBamlType NotImplementedException; model evidence is not a full original desktop screenshot.

Synthetic-owner attempts to assign fake IO labels recurse through subscription triggers and caused StackOverflow in owned probe; stable runner excludes those mutations. Binding semantics are source-confirmed only.
IsAbandon attribute is present in NImage XML but no public parser field was found. Hidden advanced rows also explicitly set CustomVisible False; do not infer universal deletion from IsAbandon.
AccessMode O does not mean disabled UI: UI-only selectors persist state and trigger operations; r/w control parameter transport separately.
No explicit Execute footer is not evidence of nonmodal lifetime. Change-triggered execution and external module commands are separate paths.
Independent mathematical and image recognition implementation remains separate; this report does not claim complete runtime or UI parity.

frameworkImplications.requirement: Preserve declared tabs/categories/control class and exact DisplayType dispatch, with per-plugin template extension and bounded explicit fallback.
Represent typed values, initialization/commit distinction, reversible triggers, cross-item conditions and inherited capabilities before rendering.
Use typed services for IO relation mutation versus numeric parameter subscription, execute/reset/save/clear/window close; render declared footer only.
Lifecycle and execution must come from original host path; do not fix architectural mismatch by per-plugin window styling or guessed modality.
